item.description:
What's New

  • Duplicate & Merge Notes!
  • CMD or Shift click to select multiple notes
  • Record and transcribe new notes completely offline
  • Use CMD+. to open the AI Preferences for easy access to Custom Instructions
  • CMD+S now autofocuses the search input and opens the sidebar if it's closed/li>
  • Changed the free plan recording limit from 10 minutes to 5 minutes

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash that could happen if you recorded blank audio
  • We now save your recording more reliably if transcription gets interrupted

What's New

  • Duplicate & Merge Notes!
  • CMD or Shift click to select multiple notes
  • Record and transcribe new notes completely offline
  • Use CMD+. to open the AI Preferences for easy access to Custom Instructions
  • Changed the free plan recording limit from 10 minutes to 3 minutes

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash that could happen if you recorded blank audio
  • We now save your recording more reliably if transcription gets interrupted

What's New

  • Added auto-complete tags when adding a new tag
  • Better looking toast messages on macOS

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash that could happen when archiving or restoring notes
  • Fixed an issue where restored notes were sorted incorrectly by date
  • Sharable link was not working when you published a note from the archive list
  • Archived notes were missing from the Published filter
  • Improved the onboarding/login process UI (Thanks Andy!)
